name: A1Z26
description: Encodes letters as their alphabet numbers.
legacyScript: function animate(env,el,p){ var t=el.text.toLowerCase(),o=[]; for(var i=0;i<t.length;i++){ var c=t.charCodeAt(i); if(c>=97&&c<=122)o.push(""+(c-96)); else if(t.charAt(i)===" ")o.push("/"); } el.text=o.join("-"); return el; }
